title: Global Entry - basics
facts: Global Entry is a CBP Trusted Traveler Program providing expedited U.S. entry processing for preapproved, low-risk travelers.
Applicants undergo background vetting and, when conditionally approved, generally complete an interview before final approval.
Approval is discretionary and membership can be revoked if program requirements are no longer met.
Global Entry members generally receive TSA PreCheck eligibility when they use the appropriate Known Traveler Number and meet TSA requirements.
